subject: Crossbeam: weekly leadership brief — wins, risks, QBR asks
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 07:12:00 -0800
Subject: Crossbeam: weekly leadership brief — wins, risks, QBR asks

Team —

Quick compact update ahead of next week's QBR prep block. This is meant to be a single-slide, three-line handoff for the exec packet. Highlights, near-term risks, and what I need from each of you. Attachments: concise QBR notes + rollup (see attachments).

Wins
- Hosted API latency P50 down 12% after the latest kernel selection changes; cost/sample improved ~8% on our benchmark suite.
- Early Dedicated pilot with Acme completed performance validation; they passed throughput SLA on our internal load tests.
- Three new repos for ops-runbooks merged; reduces on-call run time for common infra incidents by ~20% in staging.

Risks / Signals
- Model onboarding backlog: two high-priority customer model conversions (internal quantization + KV cache tuning) are slipping 3 business days due to limited infra slots. This could impact committed demo readiness for Acme (deal-ACME-4592).
- QBR ask: we need a firm decision on granting a one-week priority infra window (dedicated cluster) for the Acme cutover; otherwise we'll push demo to week+2.
- Observability retention pilot showing a higher-than-expected cost delta when retention is set to 90d; ops needs guidance on acceptable retention targets for Hosted customers during Q1.

Asks (who/what/when)
- Laura: approve the one-week priority window for Acme (cost ~ 18k incremental). If approved, I will notify infra and ops and schedule the cluster allocation by Wed 1/13 EOD.
- Vivek: align on retention guardrail — do we accept a temporary 30% cost increase for 90d retention during the pilot, or mandate alternate telemetry sampling? Decision requested by Tue 1/12.
- Maya: please consolidate the one-slide QBR entry (OKR status + customer highlight) using the attached template; share back by Tue noon so I can fold into the packet.

Notes / context links
- Acme validation log: HubSpot: deal-ACME-4592 (link in related_links).
- QBR facilitator (ConsultCo) will expect the slide deck by Thu EOD.

Attachments:
- [Attachment: 2027_Q1_QBR_prep_notes.pdf (pdf)]
- [Attachment: QBR_okr-rollup.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Thanks — short and actionable. Reply with one-line decisions.

Ben Carter
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Crossbeam: weekly leadership brief — wins, risks, QBR asks

Ben —

Thanks for the concise handoff. Two quick clarifications:
1) The incremental cost of the Acme priority window — is that one-time (cutover week) or ongoing while they're in Dedicated? If one-time, I sign off.
2) On retention, I don't want to default to a large cost increase for all Hosted customers. Acceptable interim: approve the 90d for enterprise pilots (Acme only) and require sampling-based telemetry for public tenants.

Please confirm 1) it's a one-time cutover cost and 2) that Maya will produce the slide by Tue noon.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: maya.srinivasan@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 12:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Crossbeam: weekly leadership brief — wins, risks, QBR asks

Ben / Laura —

Decision: approve one-week priority cluster for Acme as a one-time cutover expense. Finance will cover up to $18k provided the cluster is torn down within 72 hours after validation. Ops to schedule and confirm exact times.

Retention guidance: I agree with Laura — limit 90d retention to enterprise pilot toggle (Acme, plus any pre-approved enterprise customers). For Hosted standard tiers, require sampling and an upper bound of 45d unless product/CS request explicit exception. I'll have ops add a guardrail to the console by Friday.

Next steps: Ben, please open the allocation ticket and CC me; Maya, I'll review the one-slide once you draft it.

—Vivek
COO, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Perfect — thanks for the quick calls:
- Laura: confirmed, Acme window is approved as a one-time cutover expense.
- Vivek: I'll open the infra allocation ticket now and tag ops for teardown within 72h.
- Maya: noted on the slide; I'll merge your slide into the master and share the packet on Wed EOD for leadership review.

I'll also ping Acme's Sarah Jones with the proposed cutover dates once infra confirms the window.
